file_impact.reason: Single-source zero-guard: parse_retry_after returns None for a non-positive Retry-After (0/negative) so surfaces 2 (dispatch_apply_phases._call_with_retry) and 3 (jira_datacenter/retry.py) route to the already-jittered fallback instead of an immediate replay.

Parity sibling (surface 4): _rate_limit_backoff uses its own inline regex, not parse_retry_after, so it needs its own zero-guard — a matched Retry-After of 0 (or <=0) must fall through to the jittered exponential backoff rather than min(0.0, MAX)=0.0.

New held-out RED->GREEN test: asserts parse_retry_after('0')/'0.0' return None, a positive value is still honored/capped, and acli _rate_limit_backoff for Retry-After: 0 yields a jittered fallback > 0 (never sleep(0)).
